source: Written by hand from Antigravity's documented hook input and replies (its hooks page, read 2026-10-18; the same file serves the App 2.24, the CLI agy 1.4 and the IDE), with Friday's own values; not recorded from a run. The page does not say how MCP tools are named, so both spellings are here. The one set of Antigravity hook inputs: the launcher's tests and the adapter's read it. Replace with recordings after the live check (docs/integration/antigravity.md). Five inputs marked host_version 1.5 were added on 2026-11-16 after the first live session (CLI 1.5.9): read_file, edit_file and write_file (the tool names of 1.5; Path was seen for read_file and is assumed for the other two), call_mcp_tool (the lazy MCP call, the default from 1.5) and mcp_friday_friday_whoami (an eagerly loaded MCP tool), each with the common fields 1.5 added (lastUserInput, hookEventName, cwd). They are written from that session and the hooks guide shipped with the CLI, not recorded.
